note: Triennial election of Down County Council. Polling took place on Thursday 5 June 1952 in the two contested divisions, Castlewellan and Newry; the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952; Irish News, 6-7 June 1952). Majority 301. The nominations list prints the Labour candidate as 'J. T. Kelly'; the result prints 'T. Kelly'.
